contractBoundary: Current signed customer path is POST /receipt/v1 with local raven-receipt-verifier checks and an independently authenticated signer pin. POST /verify is legacy v2 compatibility. Local MCP is unsigned developer output.

surfaces.hosted_verifier: keyed POST /receipt/v1 API on Render; signed receipt-v1 evidence; server-side RPC
surfaces.local_mcp: free developer/agent-native local path (npx -y raven-verify-mcp); unsigned output against your RPC, not a signed receipt-v1
surfaces.acp_provider: sandbox only, not publicly listed or hireable; no live paid-job capability claimed
surfaces.solana_agent_kit_plugin: toolkit surface (raven-solana-agent-kit-plugin); no wallet scope needed
surfaces.static_console: human-readable docs + machine manifests; no live verification in the browser

commonRequirements: verify signed receipts before action regardless of surface
local context never overrides verifier evidence
no API keys in browser code
forbiddenClaims: fully offline FRESH verification (offline re-verification of a STORED receipt is fine: receipt + public key suffice; fresh on-chain state needs a live check)
keyHandlingRules: never in browsers, repos, agent memory, or receipts

executionModes.local_loop: dev/testing surface; must not expose .env, wallet files, browser sessions, signer material, package or deployment tokens
executionModes.local_scheduled_task: must re-verify after sleep, resume, or catch-up; missed runs must not bulk-proceed on old receipts
executionModes.cloud_routine: server-side key handling, quotas, backoff, logs, fail-closed behavior required
executionModes.backend_script: preferred for deterministic checks - signature verification and decision mapping need no LLM
executionModes.agent_sdk_harness: may call and explain Raven; may not override receipt, verdict, or gaps
executionModes.human_review_console: best place to inspect receipt, gaps, staleness, and policy before action; cannot validate invalid signatures

scheduledAgentRule: Scheduled agents re-verify before material action. Cron/loop jitter means 'scheduled at X' is not proof of freshness; catch-up runs after downtime must not bulk-proceed using old receipts. Every scheduled Raven check needs max runs, max retries, timeout, and fail-closed behavior.
